spans.s:
f. (-ण्ठिः-ण्ठी)
Dry ginger.
E.
शुठि to be stopped, (by it, phlegm,) aff. अच्, and fem. aff. ङीप्, or in one case इन् aff.

n. (-ण्ठ्यं)
Dry ginger.
E.
शुठि to be stopped, (disease by it,) and यत् aff.

m. (-ण्डः)
The exudation from an elephant's temples.
f. (-ण्डा)
1 A tavern.
2 Spirituous liquor.
3 An animal called the waterelephant, the hippopotamus perhaps.
4 An elephant's proboscis or trunk.
5 The stalk of the lotus.
6 A whore.
7 A bawd.
E.
शुण to go, aff. ड, fem. aff. टाप्.

m. (-कः)
1 A distiller.
2 A military flute or fife (?)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-नं)
A place where spirits are sold, a tavern, a dram shop.
E.
शुण्डा spirits, and पान drinking.

m. (-रः)
A distiller, a vintner.
E.
शुण्डा spirits, र aff.

m. (-लः)
An elephant.
E.
शुण्डा his trunk, लच् poss. aff.

f. (-का)
The soft palate.
E.
शुण्डा an elephant's proboscis, कन् fem. form.

m. (-ण्डी)
1 A distiller, a preparer and vender of spirituous liquor.
2 An elephant.
E.
शुण्डा spirits, &c., इनि aff.
